name: question_parameters
sql: select cast(? as bigint) + cast(? as bigint) as total, '?' as literal -- ? stays a comment
native_sql: select cast($1 as bigint) + cast($2 as bigint) as total, '?' as literal -- ? stays a comment

name: named_parameters
sql: select cast($value as bigint) + cast($value as bigint) as doubled, cast($label as varchar) as label

name: nullable_parameter
sql: select cast($1 as bigint) as value

name: aggregate_and_order
sql: select name, sum(value) as total from (values ('b', cast(2 as bigint)), ('a', cast(3 as bigint)), ('a', cast(4 as bigint))) as t(name,value) group by name order by name

name: view_setup
setup: create view corpus_values as select cast(42 as bigint) as value

name: missing_column
sql: select corpus_missing_column from (select 1 as value) as t
